terms.gloss: a bundle, a faggot, a load; in the plural, fascēs, the bundle of rods with an axe carried before the highest magistrates
evidence: Plin. Ep. 3.9.9: tot crīmina, tot reōs ūnō velut fasce complectī (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: tot crīmina, tot reōs ūnō velut fasce complectī
phrases.english: to take in so many charges and so many defendants in a single bundle, so to speak
